title: Data handling rules
content: Data types having more than 8bits (1bytes) like word and long are identified and broken down as per follow in this document.

Multiple byte are organized as little endian convention. If data type of long having value of AABBCCDDh. Then AA is MSB, BB is USB, CC is HSB and DD is LSB. More information on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Endianness.

title: Change Log
content: Removed definition of capture from command number (1Dh & 1Eh). now only alarm can be enabled or disabled. Capture option is moved to command number (47h)
Interlocking rule changed byte 17 from “RFU” to “No of doors”
Interlocking rule added bytes 66 67 68 (fail safe / fail secure mechanism)
Removed scope variables from all inputs in command Input Definitions (1Ch)
Added scope variables in command Input Action (1Dh)
Added canteen commands for (C0h to C4h)
Changed 20h (display parameter command little bit) added card id display format in an rfu byte
Changed minor version of this document
Command 17h (Reader setup) > byte index [19] > replaced from RFU to Transaction enable / disable?
Updated command 16h (Controller setup) . new parameter added, wiegand out enabled in controller mode
Corrected command 4Dh (user pin change), added byte for door id
Updated some finger print parameter values.
Added command EAh = Get pending event from service (previously EAh was designated for Push Canteen Data, but was not getting used, was duplicate of E7h, so removed header)
Renamed Obsolete Bytes named Site Code (SC) in various commands to Extended ID. Commands modified are 03h,04h,07h,0Ch,0Dh,2Dh,32h,3Bh,3Dh,41h,4Dh.
Added command MQTT Publisher Rule setup (4Fh)
Modified Controller Setup command (16h / 17h) To indicate new type transaction frame
Added a new command Temperate Sensor Para (50h).
Added new push command New Type Transaction Frame (EBh).
Added command 52h, Mifare MAD Config / Paramters
EAC reader setup command (55h)	 code id changed from ECh
Added Command D1h (Server auth query & response).
Input to Output Trigger Command (1Dh). accommodate rule reset on GPI Trigger.
